motions.title: Youth Justice Plan 2026/27
motions.full_text: No full text available, likely to be a discussion on the Youth Justice Plan for 2026/27
motions.opposition_strategy: Opposition may argue for increased funding or alternative approaches to youth justice
motions.ruling_group_response: Emphasize the plan's focus on rehabilitation and community-based initiatives, highlighting any positive outcomes or statistics

amendment_predictions.amendment_angle: Potential amendment to increase funding for youth justice initiatives
amendment_predictions.counter: Argue that the current plan is well-funded and that additional funding may not be feasible, or offer a friendly amendment to review funding allocations

motions.title: Overview and Scrutiny Work Plan and Council's Forward Plan of Key Decisions
motions.full_text: No full text available, likely to be a discussion on the work plan and forward plan
motions.opposition_strategy: Opposition may argue for increased transparency or more frequent updates on key decisions
motions.ruling_group_response: Highlight the plan's focus on accountability and transparency, emphasizing any measures in place for regular updates and public engagement

amendment_predictions.amendment_angle: Potential amendment to increase public consultation on key decisions
amendment_predictions.counter: Argue that the current plan already includes adequate public engagement mechanisms, or offer a friendly amendment to review consultation processes

questions.trap_explanation: Question may be designed to elicit a response that could be perceived as insensitive or uncaring
Question may be a genuine inquiry for information

tactical_scenarios.scenario: Opposition attempts to amend the Youth Justice Plan to include increased funding
tactical_scenarios.counter: Offer a friendly amendment to review funding allocations or argue that the current plan is well-funded

tactical_scenarios.scenario: Public questioner asks a provocative question on the Council's Forward Plan
tactical_scenarios.counter: Remain calm and composed, providing a clear and concise response that highlights the plan's focus on transparency and accountability

time_management.recommended_time_saving: Use friendly amendments on motions to reduce debate time
